card.title: Cutting a Möbius strip in half

body.question: Twist a paper strip once and tape the ends: that is a Möbius strip. Now cut it lengthwise along the middle. What do you get?
options: One longer loop, with more twists
body.reveal: One long strip with four half-twists in it. It is no longer a Möbius strip, but an ordinary two-sided band, double the length. The original has just one boundary curve and one side, and was found by Listing and Möbius in 1858; it already appears in Roman mosaics from the third century CE.
